purpose: Verify one exact raw CEV0 UpgradePlanV0 field-12 value, forbid the v0-only field-13/14 carriers on a protocol-version change, and independently verify a separately versioned CEV1 V0ActivationFirst proposal witness plus its three-QC finality proof.

compatibility_contract.source_side: The frozen-v0 EpochHandoffProof contributes its independently checked fields 1 through 11 and exact raw UpgradePlanV0 field 12 only.
compatibility_contract.target_side: V0ActivationFirst proposal/finality bytes live only in V0ToV1ActivationProofV1 under CEV1; they are never decoded as frozen-v0 Proposal or ThreeChainFinalityProof.
compatibility_contract.reason: Frozen-v0 Proposal/ThreeChainFinalityProof exact decoders accept protocol_version=0 only. Reusing fields 13/14 for protocol_version=1 would be an unversioned reinterpretation.

frozen_v0_types.canonical_round_trip: The checker strict-decodes source_upgrade_plan_cev0, rejects trailing/truncated/unknown-option bytes, exact-reencodes it, and recomputes UpgradePlanV0 hash.

V0ToV1ActivationProofV1: Hash32; candidate source-inventory binding, not consensus authority

verified_relations: UpgradePlanV0 field 12 exact-reencodes and its v0-domain hash binds activation statement, artifact manifest, target v0 parameter projection, migration program, epoch, and height.
Frozen-v0 fields 13 and 14 are absent; any attempt to signal either is rejected before CEV1 proposal/finality verification.

The pre-existing bounded activation kernel is rerun after replacing the source plan hash and freshly signing both role-isolated old/new activation quorums; NoFallback and the unique next-epoch boundary remain mandatory.
The V0ActivationFirst header uses the exact V0 terminal parent, activation statement/anchor, migration output, empty payload roots, target descriptor, and initial view.
The proposal wrapper proposer/header/set identity is exact and one strict-Ed25519 proposal-carrier signature is independently verified.
Three certified target-epoch headers exact-recompute BlockId/QC IDs; twelve strict-Ed25519 Vote signatures are independently verified with ordered unique signers and checked weighted quorum.
The first two direct parent/QC successors form the exact three-chain that finalizes V0ActivationFirst.
explicit_exclusions: frozen-v0 EpochHandoffProof fields 13 and 14 are forbidden on this cross-version path; they are not reinterpreted as CEV1
governance-state membership/finality for UpgradePlanV0 is not proved
migration execution, complete source-state authentication, audit/conservation recomputation, and output construction are not proved
the proposal carrier is a bounded candidate witness binding the exact V0ActivationFirst header and activation IDs; full OrderProposalV1 admission/transport remains outside this tranche
delayed first-view TC, arbitrary multi-hop light-client updates, signer durability, implementation, activation, production, release readiness, and normative freeze are not proved
